topic: The child who described her previous death in exact forensic detail
hook: A 3-year-old described her own murder in exact detail.
script: A 3-year-old described her own murder in exact detail. A young girl from the Golan Heights told her parents she had been murdered in a previous life. She named her killer, the village, and the location of her buried body. Investigators found the village. Found the grave. Found the man she named — who confessed. The case is documented by Dr Ian Stevenson at the University of Virginia. Follow for reincarnation cases that even scientists couldn't dismiss.
